items.name: ProposalResult
items.summary: The result of proposing a calculation in the current thread. See `propose_calculation` for more details on how it is used.

items.name: Calculation
items.summary: A cached calculation where recursive calculation returns None.

methods.name: calculate
methods.signature: fn calculate(&self, calculate: impl FnOnce() -> T) -> Option<T>
methods.summary: Perform or use the cached result of a calculation without using the full power of cycle-breaking plumbing.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Get the value if it has been calculated, otherwise `None`. Does not block on write locks — reads are unaffected.

methods.name: propose_calculation

methods.name: record_value
methods.summary: Attempt to record a calculated value.

methods.name: write_lock
methods.summary: Lock this cell for an SCC batch commit. Blocks if another SCC commit already holds the lock. Returns false (no lock acquired) if the cell is already `Calculated`, since `record_value` would be a no-op anyway.

methods.name: write_unlock
methods.summary: Write a value to a write-locked cell and release the lock. Panics if the cell is not write-locked.

methods.name: write_unlock_empty
methods.summary: Release the write lock without writing a value. Used by the RAII guard for panic cleanup.
